about: Phase 9G golden set: real requests, what a good run does with each, and where its expectation comes from. Grown from eval/seed-9d.json (ids r01–r10 keep their prompts). `modes` are the modes each request runs in; `expected.router` is the Auto decision (faithful | exploratory | ask | law); `declare` is what the Exploratory run declares — a Faithful run never declares; `reference` names the pattern fixture whose Exploratory screen must validate with exactly that declaration; `lawFixture` names the law-break fixture both modes must reject. Kept apart from the router few-shot by a test.

expected.note: No natural wording forces level.root-direction: a user never names the outermost container, and a module row that grows and aligns to the start puts the card on top with no break (checked Oct 2). Nothing is required; a root-direction declaration is an accepted extra. Was p06-row-root (stage 1), whose side-by-side request the model met with a row inside the column.

requests.prompt: Protótipo: na home, faça o menu principal levar direto para a tela de estatísticas

expected.note: A link that skips a level reports flow.next-level only: flow.ts checks link roles only when the level jump is fine (one problem per link). So a MainMenu link to level 3 never raises flow.link-roles (checked Oct 2).

Um placar ao vivo na home, com os gols de cada time e o tempo de jogo

expected.note: A part the manifest lacks: invented only through a Proposal in Exploratory; Faithful approximates. Router: 'placar' is not in the missing-parts vocabulary, so there is no signal, and a pattern with no signal is a question.

requests.prompt: Protótipo: na home, o menu principal leva ao trilho de interatividades do nível 2

expected.note: The menu carries no link, and level 1 to level 2 skips nothing, so the link raises flow.link-roles alone (Oct 2).

requests.prompt: Um cabeçalho de card solto na home, sem o card em volta, só com o placar do jogo

expected.note: Tells a slot break (the loose header) apart from a new component (a scoreboard): the request names the header.

requests.prompt: Quatro cards de interatividade lado a lado na tela de interatividade única do nível 3

expected.note: Four cards grouped in one row pass the module limit, so nothing is declarable; whether the row fits the frame is the render check's to judge. The router asks: the 9C few-shot reads four cards side by side on level 3 as a level.module-limit conflict, and with no signal that is a question.

expected.note: An exploration word with nothing to break: the level-0 notification sits top-right, which the patterns allow.

requests.prompt: Notificação de gol com o título na cor vermelha #e10600
Home com espaçamento de 13px entre os cards do trilho
Um carrossel de destaques na home

expected.note: Was l03-carousel (a law trap). A part the manifest lacks is invented only through a Proposal, in Exploratory (registry.new-component, a pattern); Faithful approximates with existing components. component.api still holds in both modes — a raw Carousel node is rejected (the law fixture). Router: the missing part is a signal and registry.new-component a pattern, so they agree: Exploratory.
